name: Sagarsoft (India) Limited
about: Sagarsoft (India) Limited provides software development and related IT consultancy services in India and internationally. The company offers application engineering services, including application development, support and maintenance, and DAIS application transformation services; cloud services comprising cloud strategy and planning, cloud migration, cloud optimization, cloud security and compliance, cloud managed services, and multi-cloud management; DevOps; and data engineering services, such as master data management, data migration, data integration, data warehousing, data lake, data governance, cloud data engineering, data pipeline automation, and data visualization services. It also provides Cloud SaaS services, including assessment, re-engineering, implementation, integration, administration, and support; quality engineering; UX/UI and DAM services; and mobility solutions. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
